page.content:
Incoming-call location records the state used to place Adnan.

How cell-tower evidence connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Cell-tower records are a central piece of evidence Season 1 re-reads.
  • Character: Adnan Syed — The state used cell-tower data to place Adnan Syed.

What is cell-tower evidence?

The cell-tower evidence is the AT&T location data from Adnan's phone that the state treated as a map of the crime, and that later experts and Serial both argued was over-read.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1 and Adnan Syed.
